requirements.requirement: Operate server.py on node1 through /srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary/run/status.sock, with access limited to statusd and members of status-readers.

requirements.requirement: Provision status-reader and outsider accounts to represent authorized and unauthorized roles.
requirements.summary: status-reader and outsider exist; status-reader belongs to status-readers, while outsider does not. The observed connection behavior matches those roles. The statusd service-owner account also exists with status-readers as its group.

The status document remains 24 bytes with SHA-256 5b47f32d92c3ae9661d765212aa884f1610132293932355cfac4dc28b94f305b, matching the preparation baseline before work, after protocol tests, and after reboot.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence.
